# BillingCadence

How often a subscription is paid for. Allowances reset every month on both.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Monthly"` |  |
| `"Annual"` |  |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

- Inside [`BillingScheduledChange`](billing-scheduled-change.md)
- Inside [`BillingStanding`](billing-standing.md)
- Inside [`EffectiveEntitlements`](effective-entitlements.md)
